title: Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement Fee Schedule: Pre-Arrival Handling of Returned Payments
content:
| Return posted before the planned arrival date | Pre-arrival handling charge |
|---|---|
| 7 days or fewer | 10.00 USD |
| 8 to 14 days | 5.00 USD |
| More than 14 days | Nothing |

**Schedule note.** On a stay under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement, the pre-arrival handling charge is ten dollars when the return was posted seven or fewer days before the planned arrival date, five dollars when it was posted eight to fourteen days before, and nothing otherwise. The charge is added to the returned-payment fee as a flat amount.

**Counting the days.** The days are the planned arrival date of the stay less the posting date of the returned-payment entry, in calendar days. A return posted on the planned arrival date counts 0 days, and one posted after it fewer than 0; both are seven or fewer.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, planned arrival 20 May)

| Return posted | Days before arrival | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| 13 May | 7 | 10.00 |
| 12 May | 8 | 5.00 |
| 6 May | 14 | 5.00 |
| 5 May | 15 | Nothing |
| 22 May (after arrival) | fewer than 0 | 10.00 |
